stem.en: I usually go to bed ___ ten o'clock.

why.en: With clock times we use at: at ten o'clock.
why.uz: Soat vaqti bilan at ishlatiladi: «at ten o'clock».
why.ru: С точным временем (по часам) используется at: at ten o'clock.

why.en: With days of the week we use on: on Sunday.
why.uz: Hafta kunlari bilan on ishlatiladi: on Sunday.
why.ru: С днями недели используется on: on Sunday.

why.ru: С временами года используется in: in summer.

stem.en: I do my homework ___ the evening.

why.en: With parts of the day we say in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.
why.uz: Kun qismlari bilan in ishlatiladi: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.
why.ru: С частями дня используется in: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.

stem.en: This is my sister Nigora. I walk to school with ___ every day.

why.en: After with we use the object form, and a sister is a girl: with her.
why.uz: With dan keyin olmoshning obyekt shakli keladi; sister qiz bola: with her.
why.ru: После with используется объектная форма местоимения; sister — девочка: with her.

stem.en: Our teacher is very kind. She helps ___ with our homework.

why.en: After a verb we use the object form us; we is a subject, and our stands before a noun.
why.uz: Feʼldan keyin obyekt shakli us keladi; we ega boʻlib keladi, our esa otdan oldin turadi.
why.ru: После глагола используется объектная форма us; we — подлежащее, а our стоит перед существительным.

stem.en: Where are my keys? I can't find ___.

why.en: Keys is plural, and after a verb the object form is them.
why.uz: Keys koʻplikda; feʼldan keyin obyekt shakli them keladi.
why.ru: Keys — множественное число; после глагола используется объектная форма them.

stem.en: This is my new bike. Do you like ___?

why.en: A bike is one thing, and after a verb we use it.
why.uz: Bike bitta narsa; feʼldan keyin it ishlatiladi.
why.ru: Bike — один предмет; после глагола используется it.

stem.en: We haven't got ___ bread at home. Let's go to the shop.

why.en: In a negative sentence we use any: haven't got any bread. Bread is uncountable, so no a or an.
why.uz: Inkor gapda any ishlatiladi: haven't got any bread. Bread sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun a yoki an qoʻyilmaydi.
why.ru: В отрицательном предложении используется any: haven't got any bread. Bread — неисчисляемое, поэтому a или an не ставится.

stem.en: I'm hungry. — There is ___ rice in the kitchen.

why.en: In a positive sentence we use some: some rice. Rice is uncountable, so no a and no many.
why.uz: Tasdiq gapda some ishlatiladi: some rice. Rice sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun a ham, many ham mos kelmaydi.
why.ru: В утвердительном предложении используется some: some rice. Rice — неисчисляемое, поэтому ни a, ни many не подходят.

stem.en: Have you got ___ pets at home? — Yes, a cat.

why.en: In a question with a plural noun we use any: any pets.
why.uz: Koʻplikdagi ot bilan soʻroq gapda any ishlatiladi: any pets.
why.ru: В вопросе с существительным во множественном числе используется any: any pets.

stem.en: There are ___ books on my desk, but there aren't any pens.

why.en: The first part is positive, so we use some; any is for the negative part.
why.uz: Gapning birinchi qismi tasdiq, shuning uchun some; any esa inkor qismida ishlatiladi.
why.ru: Первая часть предложения утвердительная, поэтому some; any используется в отрицательной части.

stem.en: This is my ___ room. He is at school now.

why.en: 's after a person shows that the thing is theirs: my brother's room.
why.uz: Shaxsdan keyingi 's narsa unga tegishli ekanini bildiradi: my brother's room.
why.ru: 's после слова, называющего человека, показывает, что вещь принадлежит ему: my brother's room.

stem.en: Our school is big. ___ library has a lot of books.

why.en: For a thing we use its before a noun: its library. It's means it is.
why.uz: Narsa uchun otdan oldin its ishlatiladi: its library. It's esa it is degani.
why.ru: Для предмета перед существительным используется its: its library. It's означает it is.

stem.en: Whose pen is this? — It is ___.

why.en: To say who a thing belongs to, we add 's to the name: Kamola's.
why.uz: Narsa kimga tegishli ekanini aytish uchun ismga 's qoʻshiladi: Kamola's.
why.ru: Чтобы сказать, кому принадлежит вещь, к имени добавляется 's: Kamola's.

stem.en: Our neighbours have two children. ___ names are Anvar and Sevara.

why.en: Before a noun we use their: their names. There is a place word, and they is a subject.
why.uz: Otdan oldin their ishlatiladi: their names. There joyni bildiradi, they esa ega boʻlib keladi.
why.ru: Перед существительным используется their: their names. There обозначает место, а they — подлежащее.
